text:
ana: FYI customer (Northbridge Capital) just dropped a deal term: 6-7 year immutable audit logs + a auditable key escrow proof. They want a concrete launch checklist by EOW.
ben: Is this SOC2-driven or regulator-mandated?
olivia: Both. Theyhave compliance auditors who require a signed timeline + ability to hand over key escrow evidence.
raj: Operationally: long retention affects storage tiering and egress costs. Need to scope search UX for archived ranges.
nana: @olivia typo: ana here.
olivia: hehe noted.
ben: Proposed split: (A) retention configuration + lifecycle enforcement, (B) exportable evidence package + signed manifests, (C) BYOK escrow handshake + legal attestation flow.
legal-bot: reminder: "All escrow protocols must be reviewed by Legal and Security before pilot" :gavel:
nana: draft ACs below, please iterate.
nana: ```
DRAFT ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- Per-tenant retention config up to 7 years; tenant-level immutable append-only store for audit events.
- Archive policy: hot (90d) -> warm (1y) -> cold (rest) with automatic lifecycle.
- Retrieval SLA: background export job produces an encrypted export bundle + signed SHA256 manifest within 72 hours of request.
- Evidence package includes: export bundle, manifest, ingestion receipts, and KMS handshake transcript.
- KMS: support customer-supplied wrap keys (BYOK) for envelope encryption. Escrow process documented; escrow proof is a signed attestation (legal template) plus HSM-signed timestamp.
- Fallback: if BYOK cannot be established, explicit customer consent required to use platform-managed keys and an opt-in contract flag.
- Security: no platform plaintext access, threat-model signoff, rotation and compromise procedures documented.
- Oncall/ops: runbook, access controls, and recovery steps included.
```
raj: Add cost acceptance: a cost delta estimate and default billing pass-through for pilot.
ben: UX needs: admin UI to set retention, request export, and view export status + manifest. Also a per-export audit trail.
olivia: For the manifest: include event-count, byte-size, start/end time, and a chain-of-custody signature. Use SHA256 and RFC3339 timestamps.
nana: Technical notes from infra: we can implement lifecycle using object store lifecycles + write-once buckets. For immutability we'll use retention locks and object holds where supported.
infra: Confirmed: s3-object-lock + versioning will cover many clouds; for on-prem we need WORM filesystems or append-only blob stores.
ben: Timelines? Discovery 4 days, legal template + escrow terms 1 week, eng spike 1 week, MVP build 3 weeks => ~6 weeks total.
raj: Risks: 1) escrow legal negotiations delay, 2) retrieval latency for cold archives, 3) cross-region residency requirements. Mitigations: pre-approved clause, staggered rollout, customer-facing SLA on retrieval windows.
nana: Sales says they'll make the pilot contractual only if we can hit the docs + checklist. They want a customer-facing one-pager.
olivia: I'll draft the one-pager for sales and the acceptance checklist.
ben: Action items: ana circulate ACs; infra to list supported storage guarantees per cloud; legal to draft escrow attestation template; eng to spec export job and manifest format.
nana: tagging folks: @legal-bot for templates, @infra please enumerate limitations by provider.
infra: will post a short matrix tomorrow.
ben: Good. One more ask: include a 'test mode' where escrow handshake can be simulated in staging for auditor review (no real key escrow).
olivia: We'll include simulated-attestation mode in staging with explicit notarization that it's a test artifact.
nana: Great. I'll compile minutes and send to Sales + Customer. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
